summary: Masbate 1st District representative with 51 principal-authored bills. Authored a lifeline electricity rate for minimum-wage earners, a lower optional government retirement age of 56, liability protection for emergency medical responders and travel-tax abolition. Co-authored a waste-treatment technology regulation bill.
caveat: Thin evidence; travel-tax abolition is a widely co-sponsored bill with little signal.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored a lifeline electricity rate for minimum-wage earners (-2) and lower optional retirement age (-1, social insurance), against travel tax abolition (+1).
